support_claim: Registry rows tie each candidate to distinct legal names, and commercial notes explicitly state that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from the Helion Robotics legal entity.

steps.fact: Candidate left referent registry:11847201 corresponds to the registered company HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED.
Candidate right referent registry:11847299 corresponds to the registered company HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD.
Commercial notes identify Helion Robotics Limited as the legal entity behind the Helion Robotics operating name.
Commercial notes state that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from the Helion Robotics legal entity discussed in the same paragraph.

The registry legal name HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED matches the Helion Robotics Limited entity named in commercial notes; the registry legal name HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD matches the Helion Industrial Systems Ltd entity characterized there as a different company.
